2608.04524.title: ODRA: Synthesizing Cognitive Behavioral Therapy Sessions with Structured Chain-Of-Thought and Dynamic Patient Resistance
2608.04524.paper_summary: Synthetic generation of Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) sessions is challenged by two competing demands: adhering to strict therapeutic structure while modeling the resistant, unpredictable behavior of real patients. Existing script-based methods fail to capture dynamic therapeutic interactions, while multi-agent approaches struggle to adhere to CBT's sequential structure; both suffer from sycophancy, producing overly compliant patients that misrepresent real clinical settings. In this work we introduce ODRA, a novel framework for synthesizing therapy dialogues through a Chain-of-Thought (CoT) strategy grounded in foundational CBT guidelines (Beck, 2020). ODRA further incorporates a resistance orchestrator to solve patient sycophancy, which employs steering techniques to elicit behaviors aligned with their resistance level. Automated and expert evaluations show that ODRA significantly outperforms existing methods across therapeutic skills, CBT alignment, and patient behavioral fidelity, with licensed psychologists preferring ODRA sessions across 12 of 13 clinical metrics. Furthermore, models fine-tuned on our dataset demonstrate superior therapeutic performance against both cooperative and resistant patients, validating that explicit resistance modeling in synthetic training data directly translates to downstream clinical robustness.
2608.04524.paper_summary_zh: 合成認知行為療法（CBT）會議的生成面臨兩個相互競爭的需求：在遵循嚴格的治療結構的同時，還要模擬真實患者的抵抗和不可預測的行為。現有的基於腳本的方法未能捕捉動態的治療互動，而多代理方法則難以遵循CBT的順序結構；兩者都存在諂媚的問題，產生過於順從的患者，這與真實臨床環境不符。在這項工作中，我們介紹了ODRA，一個通過基於基礎CBT指導原則（Beck, 2020）的思維鏈（CoT）策略合成治療對話的新框架。ODRA進一步引入了一個抵抗協調器，以解決患者的諂媚問題，該協調器使用引導技術來引發與其抵抗水平相符的行為。自動化和專家評估顯示，ODRA在治療技能、CBT一致性和患者行為忠實度方面顯著優於現有方法，持牌心理學家在13個臨床指標中有12個更偏好ODRA會議。此外，基於我們數據集微調的模型在面對合作和抵抗患者時展現出更優越的治療表現，驗證了在合成訓練數據中明確建模抵抗對下游臨床穩健性具有直接的轉化效果。
